Booked a lakeside room at Lake Ashi and arriving after work? The lake is lovely in the morning, but by 19:00 there's almost nowhere left to eat. The one mistake we'd avoid 👇

🔗 Our checked notes for this one 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-base-yumoto-gora-lake-ashi

❌ THE MISTAKE

🕖 Arriving at Moto-Hakone at 20:00 expecting a lakeside dinner.

🍕 La Terrazza Ashinoko takes last orders at 19:00 (closed 2nd and 4th Tuesdays). Most lakeside lunch places close between 16:00 and 18:00.

🚌 And on weekdays the buses up from Hakone-Yumoto thin out: 18:58, 19:48, then a last one at 20:48.

✅ THE FIX

1️⃣ Arriving by mid-afternoon? Lake Ashi is a great pick: a lake-view double with breakfast was ¥18,225 for two on our sample night.

2️⃣ Arriving later? Eat in Yumoto first. A charcoal grill 2 minutes from the station takes last orders at 21:30, then take the 20:48 bus up (21:20 at the lake).

3️⃣ Or book a lakeside hotel with its own restaurant, and check the dinner times in the listing.

4️⃣ Or switch to Yumoto for the night and ride up to the lake after breakfast: the bus takes about 32 minutes.

🌅 Do it right and Lake Ashi pays you back the next morning: Hakone Shrine's torii is about 10 minutes on foot from its bus stop, and the whole morning is yours before you move on.

🧳 Travelling with big bags? Yumoto's hotels sit next to the Romancecar platform; the lake means a 30-minute bus with your case.

👉 Breakfast with your feet in a lakeside onsen foot bath:
https://japanbystation.com/hakone-base-yumoto-gora-lake-ashi
